review_text:
In a prior life, I lived off South Grand, we are practically every nationality had a restaurant.  Walking by many times, I would always see their sandwich board sign advertising, their lunch, special of butter chicken and chicken, tiki masala.  Eventually, I got curious and wanted to stop in to try that lunch special, and it was amazing!  From that point on I ate there many times until one day I saw they had closed.  I very disappointed, I realize that operating an ethnic restaurant within a sea of other ethnic restaurants is hard to compete.  After a while, I heard that they had relocated from Tower Grove South to Forest Park, Southeast, a.k.a. The Grove.  Very happy to hear, I stopped by several times after that. They no longer have the lunch special, but make it for me when I order off menu.  

If you're looking for ambiance, this isn't your place, but good food good service and kind ownership is more important to me

When we arrived at this restaurant, we honestly thought it was closed because there was not a soul visible in the window behind the counter or in the dining room.  The only indication that they were open was the "Open" sign and a bag with takeout food on the counter.  But there is a side dining room that's not visible from the entrance.  The decor is simple and a bit primitive.  The service was wonderful and the food was delicious and very plentiful.  We had leftovers for at least one more day afterward.  It was our first experience with Afghan food and we were not disappointed.  It's probably too primitive for anything romantic or a business meeting, but for casual dining it was great.

Sameem Afghan Cafe is known for serving up great halal food in the Grove. You can taste the authentic Afghan flavors in every dish, perfectly spiced, and beautifully presented. The lamb kabobs were tender and juicy, and the bolani was perfectly crispy and flavorful. The portions are generous, and everything tastes homemade with care and presented at an affordable coats. 
The inside is quaint and the staff are friendly, attentive, and genuinely interested in ensuring you enjoy your meal. Whether you're a fan of Afghan cuisine or trying it for the first time, Sameem is a must-visit in STL for middle eastern food.

We've never had Afghani food before and we were not disappointed. We enjoyed the SLU special and chicken broast. Both were tasty and huge portions (which we finished).  Don't expect a 5 star ambiance   Rather, it's  a nondescript place that serves good food.
Easy and quick place to get decent halal food. The butter chicken was a 3/5. The chicken tenders 3.5/5 . It's my go to place when I can't think of what to cook.
The best! Hands down, one of my favorite menus in all of St. Louis. These guys put their all into their dishes. Offerings are affordable and plentiful. You'll have leftovers for the next day!

I love Sameem's. Their food is fire and everyone that I have gone with loves it. Everything is tasty and delicious. I had Sameem cater a wedding event of mine and have gone to the restaurant on a number of occasions and thoroughly enjoy the food every time. The staff is so knowledgeable and kind. I can't wait to go back!

The food at Sameem is great, always fresh and flavorful. It's my daughter's favorite restaurant in St Louis and we've been there many times. They never disappoint. The prices are good too and servers are friendly.

It was good! Very unique experience. Food is kind of a blend of middle eastern and Indian and a bit of south east Asia. Not a very fancy place, in fact I was a bit confused when I entered the door. But the food was definitely with it. Street Parking is free after 5 on Friday night. Service was fast but they used disposable cups.

My second Afghan restaurant experience, with the first being Afghan Kabob House.  I liked the Kabob House slightly more for its dining atmosphere and spice variety, but both were excellent choices.  We had the Bolini, Lamb Shank and chicken beriani.  Good choices, but if you were sharing, I would only order one of them, since both the lamb and chicken had similar rice.  The server was excellent and the food arrived quickly.
